name: Paddle Adventure Camp
description_short: Week long kayaking and hiking camp for teens entering grades 8 to 11, based at the Rye Nature Center. Each week has about three paddles and two hikes at places such as Lake Sebago, Canopus Lake, Blind Brook and Rockefeller State Park, with the camp driving campers to each site.
refund_policy_summary: Changing dates costs a $50 fee if space allows; there are no refunds or credits if you cancel (the fee can be turned into a tax deductible donation). Membership is non-refundable.
swim_waterfront_notes: Each day on the water the group has three trip leaders: two American Red Cross certified lifeguards and one nature center educator. Campers get a touring kayak, paddle, dry bag and life vest.
notes: An Environmentalist level membership ($125 or higher) is required to attend, one per family, so there is no non-member rate. Drop off 9 am and dismissal 4 pm at Rye Nature Center; the camp drives campers to trip sites. Week 1 is four days (June 29 to July 2). Need based aid through the Nature Access Fund, apply by May 1.
